book.name: Matei
book.title: Malobhe gha Mbone ngita chighajhandikwe na Matei

content: Yecho ihyoka
Lichiko lya Kupomolela pulipetita, putiputi lichiko lya lichiko lya jumapile, Maliya jwa ku kilambo chaku Magidala na Maliya jhonge jhola bhajhakujhenda kuilolekeya mambe jhela.
Pajhakupitila nnindimilo nkolongwa gwa nnema, ntumiche jwa kunane kwa Chapanga jwa Bhambo ajhakuhuluka kuhumii kunane. Ajhakulibhilimbiya lighanga paupele jha mambe jhela, na kulitamila.
Jwenio alangila ngita lumule lwa mbamba na ngobho yake ikibha nhuo ya mbuu.
Akalonda bhubhalondita mambe bhala bhajhakuhechuka hake, bhajhakubhehe ngita bhatehi kuwegha.
Ntumiche jwa kunane kwa Chapanga jhola ajhakwalobholela akakeghe bhala, “Mangota nkotoka kuhechuka, nhwalo nimanya mipalaha Yecho jwakabhambitwe panane jha nchalaba.
Abhii jhe pambano, nhwalo ayokite ngita chalongila. Nnolekehe pakagholwike.

Bhahe, nnyende kajhombe makalobholele bhabholwa bhake kubhehe Yecho ayokite kuhumii kubhawile, na jwenio nabhalongolela kujhenda ku Galilaya. Ndi nabhammona kwenio, hena, nenga nikannobhalile njwe mangota.”
Bhabhii mu jhoghopa na luhangano lukolongwa, akakeghe bhajhakubhoka kajhombe pa mambe na kubhutuka mbelo kwalobholela bhabholwa bhake.
Papalapala Yecho ajhakwapitila pwitu akakeghe bhala na kwajhambucha, “Uteeke ubhaha kwino.” Akakeghe bheniya bhajhakuheghelela na kunkamuu magholo na kunyinamila.
Peniya Yecho ajhakwalobholela, “Nkotoka kujhoghopa. Nnyende makalongolele akalongo bhango bhajhende ku Galilaya, ndi nabhamona koko.”
Akalonda mambe bhilonge ghighapitile
Akakeghe bhala pubhakibha undela kukijhendela, bhange akalonda bha mambe jhela bhajhakujhenda ku muche kwalobholela Akapiya matambiko bhakolo ilebhe yoha ipitile.
Bhahe, bhakolo bha bhapiya matambiko bhajhakukongana pamonga na akanahota, pibhajhomolila kulonge, bhajhakwapekeya akalonda bha mambe bhala mbijha twe,
na kwalaghalikiya bhalongila, “Mangota nnongela naha, bhabholwa bhake bhakahikite kilo kujhibha malelo ghake na twenga tukibha lughono tipitipi.
Na anda nduna ajhohine lilobhe lende, twenga natulongela nako na mangota name ndeka mu malagho.”
Bhahe, akalonda bhala bhajhakuitola mbijha hela, na bhajhakuhenga ngita chibhabholitwe. Malobhe gheniya ghajhakuchobhela pakate jha Akayahude na ade ngoheno.
Yecho abhapitii bhabholwa bhake
Peniya bhabholwa kome na jhumo bhala bhajhakujhenda ku kitombe chikibhii ku Galilaya, ngita chakabhalaghalikiye Yecho
Pibhammonita Yecho bhajhakunyinamila, nambo bhange pakate jhabhe bhakibha na kiholo.
Yecho ajhakwaheghelela pahina na kwalobholela, “Mbatite ukindendeke ghoha kunane kwa Chapanga na pannema pano.
Bhahe, nnyendengane mu ilambo yoha mukalitangache Lilobhe lya Chapanga kwa bhando bhoha, makatende kubhehe bhabholwa bhango, kongo mabaticha kwa liina lya Tate na lya Mwana na Uhuke gwa Chapanga.
Na kwabhola kughajheketela malobhe ghoha ngita chininaghalikiye mangota. Nenga mii pamonga na mangota kwa machiko ghoha, ade pukupehekeya nnema.”
